dct_description_sm: Historical dataset of Parks in Detroit, Michigan as of 2026. This dataset includes the geographic boundaries of city-owned parks within the Detroit Parks and Recreation Division. This Division is within Detroit's General Services Department (GSD). The General Services Department helps to make the City of Detroit a clean, safe and vibrant place. GSD manages the City's vehicle fleet, forestry services, vacant lot maintenance, and park and recreation center planning, design, improvements, and programming. Park boundary records define the physical extent of each park and are used for planning, operations, maintenance, and public information purposes. The dataset does not include privately owned open spaces, school playgrounds, or other non-Parks-and-Recreation City properties. For information on recreational programming, event permits, and reservations please refer to the Detroit Parks and Recreation official website. Each row in the dataset represents one park and includes details such as the park's name, address, council district, type, and size.
